messages:
csm_ana: FYI - Customer reported they completed signup and 3DS but onboarding credits are still 0. Account ID: acct_01G7xxxx. Region: EU.

billing-bot: Payment method verified, 3DS: success. Risk check: BIN_country != billing_address_country (DE vs FR) -> flagged for manual review.

sam: Can you paste the exact flow the customer saw? Did they get the 'credits pending' banner or an error?

csm_ana: They saw 'Welcome! Verify email to unlock credits' (they verified email). Then payment step showed '3DS authentication successful'. No blocker message after that. They DM'd us when credits didn't appear. Said they tried the API and is getting 402-like early error when creating embeddings but user-facing console shows 0 credits.

emma: Looking at payments logs for acct_01G7xxxx: 2024-05-09T14:12:07Z - card added, BIN: 400000 (country: FR). billing_address_country: DE. 2024-05-09T14:12:24Z - 3DS: success. Our gating rule rejects auto-grant when BIN-country != account.country to prevent cross-border fraud.

sam: Ok that explains it. Customer expectation is weird since 3DS passed. Can we repro quickly and a) confirm console UX and b) manually grant while we decide?

kai: Repro steps I used: 1) Create test account with email domain @company.de 2) Add card with BINmapped country FR 3) Complete 3DS -> account_state remains 'onboarding_blocked' and credits not applied. Command I ran: `SELECT state, credits_balance FROM accounts WHERE id='acct_01G7xxxx';` -> `onboarding_blocked, 0`. Logs: `risk: bin_country_mismatch -> hold_for_manual_review`.

emma: Payment team note: the rule was introduced after a fraud spike. It currently treats BIN-country mismatch as immediate hold even if 3DS passed. We do record 3DS outcome but it's not an override.

sam: For this customer, propose manual uplift + record action. Lucas, can ops apply credits and update the ticket?

lucas: Will do. Applying manual grant of onboarding credits (1000 token units) and clearing onboarding_blocked. Patch applied: `UPDATE accounts SET credits_balance='1000', state='active' WHERE id='acct_01G7xxxx';` and created audit: `manual_grant by lucas at 2024-05-09T15:03:12Z`.

csm_ana: Confirmed with customer — credits now visible and they ran a test embedding call that succeeded. :thumbsup: They want a note about why it happened so they can avoid it.

emma: Follow-ups: (1) Add clearer console messaging when BIN-country mismatches cause manual review (currently generic 'under review'). (2) Consider small policy tweak: if 3DS successful + low initial spend AND email domain and billing address share a region overlap, do auto-grant with extended monitoring. (3) Add an admin endpoint to surface exact gating reason.

sam: I've opened an internal ticket ENG-ops-1142 to add the admin reason endpoint and to change console copy. Will also add a one-off rule to auto-grant for charge_amount == 0 and 3DS==success for EU test flows.

kai: Note: make sure any auto-grant doesn't re-open the fraud window. We'll prototype with a short monitoring window and transaction sampling.

lucas: Ticketed and manual grant logged. I'll leave the audit doc in /ops/grants/2024-05-09-acct_01G7xxxx.md.

csm_ana: Customer thanked us and asked for ETA on UX change. Sam - assign the ENG-ops ticket to UX and payments owners.

sam: Assigned to emma (payments) and priya (ux). ETA request noted. Will update this thread when we have timeline.

emma: Quick action item: I'll push a console copy update this sprint and provide a risk/benefit note for the auto-grant proposal.

lucas: Closing loop here — customer notified, credits applied, audit recorded. If anyone sees similar cases, drop them into ENG-ops-1142.

sam: Thanks all.
